result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both forms keep their labels visible and use constrained controls. A uses selects and boat steppers with a 0-of-6 people cap, and B uses a time select and duration radios. B wins because it says everything is required unless marked, labels the mobile number as optional and promises the price before sending. A groups fields better under headings (trip, boats, details) but shows no required/optional distinction. Neither screenshot shows the submit button or total, so item 5 is scored on limited evidence. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B groups the form better, with headed sections for Your trip, Boats and Your details. Its kayak steppers show the per-hour price and a running '0 of 6 people' count, so the 6-person limit is enforced. A is the only one that explains required versus optional and marks Mobile as optional, but it has no section headings, and B doesn't show which fields are optional. Both screenshots cut off before the submit button and total, so I scored item 5 at 3 for each answer.
